changes.comment: ai-assist: add MCP_TASK_SUPPORT_VALUES, McpTaskSupport and the mcpTaskSupport converter, the MCP Tool.execution.taskSupport vocabulary ('forbidden' | 'optional' | 'required'; absent means 'forbidden'), declared beside IAiToolAnnotations so a browser consumer can use it without the Node-only @fgv/ts-extras-mcp. The converter accepts a present value only; applying the absent-means-forbidden default stays the caller's decision.
